= a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Somatic Shell''' is a [[wand]] [[attack]] [[active skill|skill]] that fires a [[projectile]] that automatically targets a nearby enemy, dealing damage and applying a shell to the first enemy hit. While the enemy has a shell, it will take [[hit]] damage from the shell's life before the enemy's life or [[energy shield]]; when fully depleted, the shell will explode, dealing significant [[area]] damage and firing another projectile towards a random target which applies a new shell to the first enemy hit by the projectile. ==Skill functions and interactions== It is possible to have multiple shells on different enemies at once; however, a shell will only be created on the first enemy hit by any projectile per skill use or per explosion. '''Explosion''': The explosion is not considered [[projectile]] damage. Damage from the explosion cannot be taken by shells. Shells created by attacks which deal no damage will take damage from other skills but will not cause an explosion when the shield is fully depleted. '''Additional projectiles''': Modifiers to projectile count apply to both the initial fired projectile as well as the projectiles fired when a shell explodes. However, it is new shells are still limited to the first enemy hit per skill use or explosion, regardless of the number of projectiles fired. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Shell
